user.title: Mashov
user.description:
Enter your credentials. Pick your school from the dropdown (type to filter).

Choose only the data you need. Existing hubs retain their previous selection.

Full message content is off by default. Enabling it marks fetched conversations as read in Mashov, even if you have not opened them yourself.

data_description.mailbox_limit: Up to 50 recent inbox conversations. Older conversations and attachment files are not fetched.
